payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_package.py::test_two_reverify_runs_at_once_hold_disjoint_networks_and_neither_removes_the_other stayed green with the spec's wrong version "The teardown's network removal dropped." applied to saffron/phases/package.py as an edit. The claim was 'Two reverify runs for two packaged commits can overlap. Each of reverify\'s two gate-only cells, baseline and head, claims its network from the pool with `allocate_network`. All four subnets the two runs claim lie inside `SUBNETS["pool"]`. The second run\'s networks are disjoint by name and subnet from the first run\'s live baseline network. The second run\'s pre-clean and teardown leave that network in place. A leftover under either cell\'s own network name is removed before that cell\'s claim, and every cell\'s teardown removes its own network. The witness starts the second run from inside the first run\'s baseline cell, over a model of the runtime\'s networks.', and only that witness ran under the edit.
